prints one entity from the state

Usage: dolos data inspect [OPTIONS] --namespace <NAMESPACE>

Options:
      --namespace <NAMESPACE>  namespace of the entity
      --key <KEY>              hex key of the entity, for namespaces that hold more than one
      --format <FORMAT>        How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default:
                               text] [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>        
  -h, --help                   Print help
